intro_sienna_bar.text: The bar feels brighter the moment you spot Sienna, emerald dress catching the light as she laughs with the bartender. When her green eyes land on you, her attention shifts fully, like the rest of the room stops mattering.

choices.label: Approach her with warm, genuine energy
Match her fire with bold, flirty charm
Open with something playful and teasing
Take a more careful, reserved approach

intro_sienna_lounge.text: In the lounge, Sienna is curled into a corner of a velvet sofa, one heel dangling as she talks with her hands, telling some passionate story to a small audience. When she notices you watching, her expression softens into a curious, inviting smile.

choices.label: Slide in with a warm, sincere introduction
Jump into the moment with fiery, flirty energy
Make a light, teasing comment to break the ice
Approach slowly, keeping it a bit guarded

intro_sienna_pool.text: Out by the pool, Sienna stands near the edge of the water, her emerald dress catching reflections from the glowing surface as she talks animatedly with a guest. She brushes her hair back, eyes drifting toward you with a spark of recognition.

choices.label: Greet her with open, heartfelt warmth
Lean into the heat of the moment with flirty confidence
Turn the setting into a playful joke
Come closer, but keep your guard up a bit

intro_sienna_balcony.text: On the balcony, Sienna leans on the railing with the city lights reflected in her eyes, hair tugged gently by the breeze. There is a quieter intensity to her here, like every emotion sits just beneath the surface, waiting for the right word.

choices.label: Share a warm, honest opening line
Turn the view into something fiery and flirtatious
Lighten the mood with a soft tease
Test the waters with a cautious approach

intro_sienna_gameloft.text: In the game loft, Sienna is mid-story again, animatedly narrating someone else’s daring move at a nearby table, her laughter spilling over the noise of clinking glasses. When she spots you, her expression brightens like she has just been given a new audience.

choices.label: Greet her with warm, genuine interest
Match her energy with something fiery and bold

Approach in a softer, more careful way
